title: Check the R480 leaver rank bill
body:
## Summary
- The gauge44-leaver8 inventory has 480 helpers. Seventy-two calls of its paid profile plus the idle remainder reproduce rank mass 520,704 and live count 7,168.
- The paid profile keeps local mass 5,586 by exchanging fourteen rank-3/rank-5 pairs for twenty-eight rank-4 children. Its packing ceiling stays below the selected word, and the pinned endpoint stays below the selected kappa.
- Partial check only. No new kappa and no catalogue-dual replay.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/r480-leaver-rank-bill/verify.py`
